executive_brief: MediReserve is a secure healthcare application utilizing an Event-Driven Architecture to ensure scalability and reactivity. The system implements a Python FastAPI backend with PostgreSQL and a React TypeScript frontend, strictly adhering to RGPD and HDS standards for sensitive health data processing. The core value proposition centers on high-integrity data handling, mandatory encryption at rest, and a rigorous quality-gated development workflow.

architectural_constraints: Minimum test coverage >= 80% for all new code
Strict input/output validation via Pydantic schemas
Mandatory code review for all changes
Automated tests must pass prior to merge into main branch
Strict adherence to YAGNI principle to prevent over-engineering
Compliance with RGPD and HDS health data standards

maturity_assessment: The project specifications are highly stable and structurally sound, exhibiting a strong alignment between security requirements and technical implementation. While a minor low-severity gap exists regarding the absence of a formal 'Open Questions' section, the comprehensive definition of testing gates and compliance standards renders the project READY for execution.
critical_dependencies: HDS (Hébergeur de Données de Santé) certified hosting environment
RGPD compliance framework for health data processing
JWT/OAuth2 identity provider for authentication and authorization
Strict dependency: Automated test success (Unit & Integration) -> Branch Merge
Strict dependency: Pydantic schema validation -> FastAPI backend integrity
Referential link: Feature implementation -> Associated specification documentation
